## Heading *emphasis*

Ordinary paragraph with **strong text**, *emphasized text*, `inline code`
and [a local link](#heading-emphasis).
The second source line belongs to the same paragraph.[^existing]

- Tight item with **item emphasis**.
- Parent item
  - Nested child with *child emphasis*.
- [X] Checked item.
- [ ] Unchecked item.
- [/] Partial item.

Term
: Definition body with **definition emphasis**.

## Blocks

```go
fmt.Println("source block")
```

| Column | Value |
|--------|-------|
| Cell   | Text  |

[^existing]: Existing footnote body.
